subject: billing when you exceed your plan's hour-limit

messages.author: 33dc9c6d026ee296
messages.subject: billing when you exceed your plan's hour-limit
parts:
Ive got a running app that is getting a bit more attention that I had expected.  If the trend continues then in four more days I'll be over my hour-limit for the month.

What is the monetary consequence?  Is my credit card automatically billed for the difference between my current plan and the next higher plan?  And is this for the one month only, or am I bumped to the higher plan permanently?

Thanks,
Homer

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] billing when you exceed your plan's hour-limit
parts:
Homer,

Currently we do not change for overages on active hours. In the future, per the terms of our shinyapps.io terms of use, we will change a small overage fee on a per-hour basis for users who are over their subscription limit. We've not yet determined what that fee would be.

So you need not worry for the time being.

-Andy
